The primary operational bottleneck identified in the text is the inefficient logistics of tool and material retrieval. The construction crew relies on a single central repository, forcing workers to travel significant distances across the site. This results in lost productivity due to excessive time spent commuting between the repository and various construction areas.

To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing the supply chain by establishing smaller, localized storage points or tool caches closer to active work zones. This would reduce travel time, minimize downtime, and allow workers to focus more on construction tasks rather than logistics.
